question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

RESOLUTION
solution:
The correct answer is- 'decision' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's understand the meaning of the given word:
 
• The word resolution is a **noun** and it means *a promise to yourself to do or to not do something*. (अपने आप से कुछ करने या न करने का वादा।)
 
 
• Example: *I made a **resolution **to give up chocolate.*
 
 
 
• By this meaning, we can say that 'decision' is a similar word to 'resolution.'

Thus *option 4 *is the correct answer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The antonyms of the given word are:

 
 
• Lethargy, apathy, flexibility, timidity
 
 
 
• The meaning of the given options is:
 
 
• decision - The act of making up your mind about something (किसी चीज़ के बारे में अपना मन बनाना)
 
• apathy - An absence of emotion or enthusiasm (भावना या उत्साह का अभाव)
 
• flexibility - Being adaptable or variable (अनुकूलनीय या परिवर्तनशील होना)
 
• timidity - Fear of making decisions (निर्णय लेने का डर)
